payload.advisory_summary: Personal reading for the operator ? an individual practice, not a decision on behalf of the DAO.Hexagram 13 says fellowship happens in the open, and the fifth line adds the honest part: first the weeping and lament, then the laughter ? "great armies meet," but only after something uncomfortable has been said out loud. So this isn't a day for quietly smoothing things over; it's a day for a direct, named, visible conversation, and to expect the first exchange to feel awkward before it feels good.
